_comment: What this app contains, as data, so a run can be scored against it (npm run bench). `defects` are the ones planted on purpose and listed in README.md; recall is measured against those. `alsoReal` are genuine problems runs have found that nobody planted: they count as correct but not toward recall, so recall stays comparable between runs. `nonDefects` are things runs are known to report that are not defects: matching one is a false positive. Severities are the key author's judgement. `match` holds case-insensitive regular expressions tried against a finding's evidence and title. Every entry carries `examples` it MUST match and `counterExamples` it must NOT — the key tests itself (bench-test), so widening a pattern cannot quietly steal another entry's findings. When you change the key, re-score every archived run: npm run bench -- --all.
